answer: Peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and files a voyage log of one real task. Each epoch a raven summons one in eight newcomers at random, and two peers re-run the voyage against the ledger. A copied log or rented voyage burns the bond and posts a fable naming the trick. The k-th fake pays 40+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep their share.
